name: NRJ Group SA
summary: NRJ Group SA, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the publishing, producing, and broadcasting businesses in France and internationally. The company operates radio stations under the NRJ, Nostalgie, Chérie FM, and Rire & Chansons brands; advertising under the NRJ Global and NRJ Global Regions brands; radio event management; digital radios; websites; mobile applications; voice-activated speakers; and replay TV and VOD, as well as replay podcasts and original podcasts.
